identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][20.c] Run six-hour Agent Logic Spot qualification only after operator and cost authorization

values.summary: Implemented the six-resident Ollama Runtime/ACC qualification, signed #414 dehydration and restored-spec continuation, Runtime-owned replay denial, retained EBS installation provenance, and one-attempt On-Demand wrapper.
actual_changes: Six distinct resident identities execute issue-owned runtime.observe tasks through Runtime UTS-to-ACC, Freedom Gate, and the Runtime adapter.
Post-recovery work consumes the #414 restored population and Runtime denies attempted replay before adapter dispatch.
Retained Runtime binaries are rebuilt only when stable Runtime/ACC source identity changes; the retired standalone provider adapter is absent.
The launch design and wrapper bind one On-Demand r7i.2xlarge attempt to the USD 20 and 25,200-second ceilings.
